items.title: Land isolated-clone runtime
items.exit_criteria: Complete: main installs shared packages from immutable Git sources without sibling repositories.

items.title: Reconcile workspace policy authority
items.exit_criteria: Any still-useful policy-only text is reconciled in TheHub without changing the merged isolated-clone runtime.

items.title: Disposition rescued frontend and signal history
items.exit_criteria: Every rescued path is retained, superseded or rejected with no stale signal promotion.

items.title: Decide producer-contract skill removal
items.exit_criteria: Skill disposition is documented; runtime delivery does not depend on it.

items.title: Build Puerto Rico pre-official source tranche
items.exit_criteria: Bounded PREB, AAA, COR3 and legislative sources run with complete acquisition accounting.

items.title: Implement Matter stages 0-6 and MoneySweep handoff
items.exit_criteria: Centinelas local lifecycle, idempotent record linking, receipt persistence, failure and retry states are implemented; shared-store and MoneySweep reconciliation require cross-repository certification.

items.title: Refresh production ledger and validate Hub export
items.status_detail: Fresh non-synthetic ledger passes signal schema, production guards, and TheHub package validation. Certification remains open because raw feed bytes, per-source zero-versus-failure accounting, and row-level classifier method bindings were not retained.
items.exit_criteria: A fresh non-synthetic ledger passes production guards and TheHub package validation with durable receipts.
